verdict.rationale: Figma Make generates frontend apps from chat prompts. Its docs also say that describing what you want in chat creates a Payload-powered backend with database, file storage, authentication and an admin panel, and that it updates both the data model and the interface together. However, the marketing copy frames this as a sequence ('Generate... your frontend..., then create a backend'), so a single prompt producing both is not shown. missing for 10: evidence that one prompt generates both UI and backend at once, documentation of custom backend business logic beyond data/auth/storage scaffolding, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate both frontend UI and backend logic from a single prompt

citations.quote: Describe what you want to build in the chat, and Make can create a Payload-powered backend, including a database, file storage, authentication, and an admin panel.
Make updates the data model and the interface to support the new fields.
Generate and design your frontend in Figma Make, then create a backend to manage your content.
The generated Payload and Next.js code is included in your Make project.
